Consumer Checking Account Agreement
First Example Bank, N.A. ("we", "us") provides this agreement under U.S. federal law.
- A monthly maintenance fee of $12.00 applies to your account.
- The fee is waived if you maintain a minimum daily balance of $1,500.
If an item is presented when your account has insufficient funds, we may pay it and charge an overdraft fee of $35.
Interest on savings is paid at a variable rate, e.g. 0.5% today, and the rate may change at any time.
We do not charge a fee for online statements.
